name: instruct_bench_summarized
description: A summarized instruction-following benchmark focused on math problems, designed to evaluate model ability to solve mathematical tasks given instructional prompts. It emphasizes solution correctness and concise answer generation for math reasoning scenarios, often used with retrieval-augmented setups.
reputation: A niche, task-focused subset used mainly in research on retrieval-augmented math reasoning; modest adoption compared to larger math benchmarks.
